question: List all venues in NSW.
gold_sql: SELECT venue_name FROM dim_venue WHERE state = 'NSW'

question: What was total revenue across all venues?
Total revenue by state, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT v.state, ROUND(SUM(f.revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM fact_play f JOIN dim_venue v ON v.venue_id = f.venue_id GROUP BY v.state ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: Which game made the most revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT g.game_name FROM fact_play f JOIN dim_game g ON g.game_id = f.game_id GROUP BY g.game_name ORDER BY SUM(f.revenue) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Total plays per brand.
gold_sql: SELECT v.brand, SUM(f.plays) FROM fact_play f JOIN dim_venue v ON v.venue_id = f.venue_id GROUP BY v.brand

question: Revenue in February 2026.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) FROM fact_play WHERE play_date >= '2026-02-01' AND play_date < '2026-03-01'

question: Monthly revenue for Timezone George St.
gold_sql: SELECT substr(f.play_date, 1, 7) AS month, ROUND(SUM(f.revenue), 2) FROM fact_play f JOIN dim_venue v ON v.venue_id = f.venue_id WHERE v.venue_name = 'Timezone George St' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: Average revenue per play for each game category.
gold_sql: SELECT g.category, ROUND(SUM(f.revenue) / SUM(f.plays), 2) FROM fact_play f JOIN dim_game g ON g.game_id = f.game_id WHERE f.revenue IS NOT NULL GROUP BY g.category

question: For each game launched in 2026, what is its total revenue across all dates in the data? Return game name and revenue rounded to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT g.game_name, ROUND(SUM(f.revenue), 2) FROM fact_play f JOIN dim_game g ON g.game_id = f.game_id WHERE g.launch_date >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY g.game_name

question: Top 3 venues by total plays.
gold_sql: SELECT v.venue_name FROM fact_play f JOIN dim_venue v ON v.venue_id = f.venue_id GROUP BY v.venue_name ORDER BY SUM(f.plays) DESC LIMIT 3
